result.markdown:
The best HR software for a small company depends on your employee numbers, location, and whether you want payroll included.

**My overall recommendation would be BambooHR for dedicated HR management, or Employment Hero if you're a UK-based small business looking for a broader HR platform.**

Here are the platforms I'd shortlist in 2026.

## Best HR software for small companies

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. BambooHR**

(Best overall for HR management)

- Employee records and documentation
- Holiday and absence management
- Onboarding and offboarding
- Performance reviews and reporting

Best for companies wanting an easy-to-use central HR system.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

**2\. Employment Hero**

(Best UK small-business option)

- HR administration and employee records
- Holiday and absence tracking
- Recruitment and onboarding
- Employee self-service and workflows

Particularly worth considering for UK businesses wanting HR and workforce management together.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/uk/)

![Charlie Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/noUj6MXVV_rGiJLKtx7Sco_uFMazap-Xj1f5ZnbuWxRGBtoatMU6LXITBFxA8JUNPcWFD9T5pr_JiMeu656E7ai9bkUmdzZ5rOMZPBS9cgUZr_b99qJ7RflQxghLNMkwNZfoMUQ-02gNA9PIKaI2sy72PQwjqiP-vw0XxBZrHM6gFjfEXb1dklqCyzGWic1V?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. CharlieHR**

(Best for simplicity)

- Staff records
- Holiday management
- Onboarding
- Performance management

A good option for smaller UK teams that don't need an overly complicated HR system.

[CharlieHR website](https://www.charliehr.com/)

---

![CIPD Festival of Work 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/5uRyCVFXTLopovDsPtSjuuu7XX9F-BJi01QUPCXHMdmnjXLbzYZ0_7fiqRJ557qEOYiPKm0lSDmShoh9Hv0KmiYCiEJR5i1DMTBBveTrsOX3WXgPsfEuIfeEnXbp8TQpTL6sic8kIvmDY-HbAGcJP6BlMY3-bXpMo1b03otLRLw88w0gEHrv-3kpxciZR4f0?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. HiBob**

(Best for growing companies)

- Employee engagement
- Performance and objectives
- People analytics
- Organisational management

Better suited to businesses expecting to grow and develop more sophisticated HR processes.

[HiBob website](https://www.hibob.com/)

(Best for automation)

- HR and payroll
- Employee onboarding
- IT and software access
- Automated workflows

Excellent functionality, although it may be more than a very small company needs.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

## Quick comparison

| Software | Best suited for | Complexity |
|--------|--------|--------|
| BambooHR | General HR management | Low |
| Employment Hero | UK HR and workforce management | Medium |
| CharlieHR | Small UK teams | Low |
| HiBob | Growing businesses | Medium |
| Rippling | HR and IT automation | Medium–high |


These recommendations reflect current 2026 comparisons; pricing and features depend on modules and employee numbers. Ideally, it should include\:

- Employee database and document storage
- Holiday and sickness tracking
- Absence reporting
- Digital onboarding and contracts
- Probation and performance reviews
- Employee self-service portal
- HR reporting and reminders
- Payroll integration

search_results.description: TechRadar’s 2026 guide evaluates leading HR software for payroll, compliance, recruitment, onboarding, benefits, performance management, and employee administration. Gusto is named best overall for its full-service payroll, time tracking, benefits administration, compliance support, and HR guidance. Employment Hero is recommended for small and medium-sized businesses because of its customizable workflows, automation, AI assistant, and broad feature set, though advanced functions and add-ons can increase costs. Rippling is best for versatility, particularly for distributed teams, offering remote device management, tax registration, scalable services, and per-employee billing. Other recommendations include Remote Payroll for international enterprises, BambooHR as an all-in-one system, Zoho People for integrations, Breathe HR for simple employee management, Deel for powerful global HR capabilities, PeopleHR for mobile access, Paylocity for mid-sized businesses, Staffology Payroll for complex enterprise payroll, Workable for recruitment, and BrightHR for extensive workforce-management features. The guide advises selecting software according to company size and specific workflow needs, and explains that testing considered usability, features, security, support, pricing, and user feedback.
